name: DonorPerfect
description: DonorPerfect is a comprehensive fundraising software designed to help non-profit organizations manage their donor relationships, track donations, and streamline their fundraising efforts. It offers tools for donor management, online fundraising, event planning, and reporting, making it easier for organizations to engage with their supporters and maximize their fundraising potential.

events.d: Creates a new donor/contact record in DonorPerfect, or updates an existing one if a Donor ID is supplied.
Create a new gift or update one by Gift ID; set donor, date, amount, and optional field groups.
Search donors by email, donor ID, name, or address fields; returns up to 500 recent donors if no search provided.
List donations from DonorPerfect, filtered by donor or record type.
